summary: This repository represents 'Build In Public University', an educational platform with a hierarchical structure containing courses, livestreams, and blog posts. The primary course is 'PVE Markets - Long Case Study' with interactive HTML components and supporting assets, supplemented by a secondary course on 'Responsible AI'. The content is organized chronologically for livestreams and thematically for posts, suggesting a growing educational community focused on entrepreneurship, economics, and public building.
insights: Multi-modal learning architecture: The structure combines theoretical content (markdown posts), interactive web applications (HTML/JS games), and live educational events (timestamped livestreams), indicating a comprehensive learning ecosystem

Asset-driven course design: The PVE Markets course relies on four JavaScript modules (course.js, network-game.js, network.js) plus styling, suggesting interactive simulations and gamified learning experiences rather than passive content consumption

Content taxonomy reveals three distinct layers: foundational concepts (01-08 numbered concept files), practical application (assignment.html, game.html), and evidence/verification (receipt.html, dashboard-evidence)
Chronological livestream organization by date/month/year indicates a structured content calendar with themed series (Memetic Marketing Monday, Technical Tutorial Tuesday, Weird Wacky Wednesday)

Post collection spans meta-commentary (about.md, manifesto), economic theory (first-principles-economics.md, decentralized-planned-economies.md), and personal narrative (origin-story.md, professor-profile), suggesting educational content integrated with founder/community storytelling
